ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is Cl3Al, and a negative sign is marked near Al; Al is connected to one Cl. A positive sign is marked near this Cl, and this Cl is connected to the central C. The central C is connected to H on the right by a single bond, and is connected to O above by a double bond; lone pair electron marks are around O. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, only the static connection relationships are retained: O is double-bonded to C; C is single-bonded to H and the positively charged bridging Cl; this [Cl+] is single-bonded to the negatively charged Al; Al is also connected to three terminal Cl. Therefore it can be written along the main chain as O=C[Cl+][Al-], and the three Cl on Al are written in as branches/continuation, giving the SMILES: O=C[Cl+][Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First inspect the image and list only the static connectivity: O double-bonded to C; C bonded to H and to a positively charged bridging chlorine; that chlorine bonded to negatively charged aluminum; aluminum bonded to three terminal chlorines. Then convert this graph into a valid SMILES string by choosing the path O=C-[Cl+]-[Al-] and adding the three Al-bound Cl branches, yielding O=C[Cl+][Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是 Cl3Al，并在 Al 附近标有负号；Al 与一个 Cl 相连。该 Cl 附近标有正号，并且该 Cl 与中心 C 相连。中心 C 与右侧 H 单键相连，并与上方 O 以双键相连；O 周围有孤对电子标记。图中还有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：忽略箭头后，只保留静态连接关系：O 双键连接 C；C 单键连接 H 和带正电的桥连 Cl；该 [Cl+] 单键连接带负电的 Al；Al 还连接三个末端 Cl。因此可沿主链写作 O=C[Cl+][Al-]，并把 Al 上的三个 Cl 作为分支/延续写入，得到 SMILES：O=C[Cl+][Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct visual-to-SMILES transcription is the natural and essentially unique route: identify the atoms, bonds, and formal charges in the drawn transition-state structure while ignoring curved arrows, then encode that connectivity in SMILES.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawing as a carbonyl carbon double-bonded to O, single-bonded to H, and single-bonded to a Cl atom; that Cl is also bonded to an Al center bearing three additional Cl substituents. Note the shown positive charge on the bridging Cl and negative charge on the Al-containing fragment; ignore the curved reaction arrows and lone-pair dots.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to provide the SMILES expression for the depicted transition-state structure and to disregard the arrows in the image.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: write the carbonyl as O=C with the aldehydic H implicit on carbon; bracket atoms with nonstandard formal charges as [Cl+] and [Al-]; represent the three terminal chlorides on aluminum as branches, giving [Al-](Cl)(Cl)Cl.
